caption: 3 debts, $300 extra a month. Avalanche (highest rate first): $1,163 interest. Snowball (smallest first): $1,203, but your first win comes 4 months sooner. Both beat the minimums by $2,200+. Illustration, not advice. #debt #debtfree #money #personalfinance

0% for 12 months: $3,000 at $150 a month leaves $1,200 when the rate jumps to 22%. The fix: balance ÷ months left. $3,000 ÷ 12 = $250. Illustration, not advice. #creditcard #debt #money #personalfinance
$5,000 on a 22% card, no payments: about $7,700 in 2 years, $14,872 in 5. Nearly triple. Compounding works against you too. Illustration, not advice. #creditcard #debt #money #personalfinance
$10,000 invested once at 7%: $20,097 in 10 years, $40,387 in 20, $81,165 in 30, $163,114 in 40. The money does the work. Illustration, not advice. #investing #compoundinterest #money #personalfinance

50% off a $400 item: you didn't save $200, you spent $200. Invested at 7% for 20 years: about $808. Make the list before the sale. Illustration, not advice. #blackfriday #saving #money #personalfinance

$1,000 of gifts on a 22% card. Minimum payments: almost 6 years, $766 interest. $100 a month: 12 months, $115. Budget before you shop. Illustration, not advice. #holidays #creditcard #debt #personalfinance
2% raises, 4% inflation: $50,000 becomes $55,204 on your payslip, but only $45,374 in today's money. A real raise beats inflation. Illustration, not advice. #inflation #salary #money #personalfinance

95 inland: R30.24 a litre. A 50-litre tank: R1,512. The R1.50 levy cut saves R75 a tank until 1 Dec, then R1 (R50 a tank) until 5 Jan. Plan the December drive. #southafrica #petrolprice #fuel #personalfinance

Two rate hikes in 2026. A R1.5m bond over 20 years: R14,725 a month at prime 10.25%, R15,228 now at 10.75%. +R503 a month, R120,000+ over the loan. Illustration, not advice. #southafrica #homeloan #interestrates #personalfinance
R1.5m bond at 10.75% over 20 years: R2.15m in interest. Add R1,000 a month: paid off 3.5 years sooner, R451,519 less interest. Illustration, not advice. #southafrica #homeloan #bond #personalfinance

TFSA limit: R46,000 a year, R500,000 lifetime. Max it from 30, done by 41. Left to grow to 65 at 6% real: about R3m, tax-free. Fill it early, then leave it alone. Illustration, not advice. #southafrica #tfsa #investing #personalfinance

R2,000 a month into an RA = R24,000 a year. At a 31% tax rate SARS refunds R7,440, so each R2,000 really costs R1,380. Tax later, refund now. Illustration, not advice. #southafrica #retirementannuity #sars #personalfinance

R30,000 in your two-pot savings pot. Withdraw it at 31% tax: R9,300 to SARS, R20,700 to you. Leave it 25 years at 6% real: about R134,000 in today's money. Just know the price. Illustration, not advice. #southafrica #twopot #retirement #personalfinance

A raise into a higher tax bracket never leaves you with less. R380k to R400k: only the R16,900 above R383,100 is taxed at 31%. Extra tax R6,045, you keep R13,955. It taxes the next rand, not every rand. #southafrica #tax #sars #personalfinance

95 inland: R20.30 in March, R30.24 now. +49% in 8 months. A 50-litre tank: R1,015 then, R1,512 now. Two tanks a month: almost R1,000 extra. Oil is global, your tank is not. Figures only. #southafrica #petrolprice #fuel #personalfinance

Your house is not an investment. $400k home, $320k at 6.5%: $408k interest. Plus tax, insurance, maintenance: $1.1m paid over 30 years. Worth after 30 years at 3.5%: $1.1m. You broke even. Illustration, not advice. #realestate #mortgage #money #personalfinance

A 1% fee costs more than your house. R5,000 a month for 40 years: R31.6m at 10%, R23.4m at 9%. The fee takes R8.2 million. Nobody feels 1%. Everybody feels 8 million. Illustration, not advice. #investing #fees #money #personalfinance

Lotto jackpot: 1 in 20,358,520. 58x more likely to be hit by lightning. R20 a week for 40 years: R41,600 on tickets, or about R227,000 invested at 7%. Play for fun. Don't call it a plan. Illustration, not advice. #lotto #money #investing #personalfinance

Bank fees: R99 a month is typical, R250 for premium. Over 40 years that's R47,520 or R120,000 in fees. Invested at 7% instead: R260k or R656k. Cheapest accounts: under R10. Check what you pay for. Illustration, not advice. #bankfees #southafrica #money #personalfinance

Two-pot, first 5 months: 2.4 million withdrawals, R43 billion out of retirement savings. Left 25 years at 6% real: R194 billion in today's money. Before you withdraw, do the maths. Source: SARS. Illustration, not advice. #twopot #southafrica #retirement #personalfinance
